items.title: Peppa Pig (Latin American dub)
items.whereToFind: YouTube: search "Peppa Pig en español latino"
items.why: Short, very clear episodes about everyday life. Easy input like this builds speed and confidence.

items.title: Pocoyó (Español Latino)
items.why: Very short, very slow episodes where the narrator describes exactly what's on screen. Easy listening for tired days.

items.title: Bluey (Spanish dub)
items.why: Seven-minute episodes about family life, full of everyday phrases parents and kids really say. Funny for adults too.

items.title: Super Easy Spanish
items.whereToFind: YouTube: Easy Spanish channel, "Super Easy Spanish" episodes
items.why: The beginner series from Easy Spanish: slow, clear everyday conversations in the street, with Spanish and English subtitles.

items.title: Simple Stories in Spanish
items.whereToFind: Any podcast app; transcripts at smalltownspanishteacher.com
items.why: Short stories told slowly, with transcripts. Stories are easier to follow than conversations, so you understand more at A2.

items.title: Coffee Break Spanish
items.why: A teacher and a learner working through real conversations step by step. Uses some English, which helps on harder topics.

items.title: How to Spanish Podcast
items.why: One topic per episode, all in Spanish, with a Mexican expression in each. A good step up from learner stories.

items.title: Intensa-Mente (Inside Out)
items.why: A story you probably know, all about feelings: the vocabulary for describing emotions comes up again and again.

items.title: Destinos
items.whereToFind: Some local PBS stations; no longer free online (Annenberg Learner closed in 2026)
items.why: A telenovela made for learners: a mystery that pulls you into watching every day, across Spain, Argentina, Puerto Rico and Mexico.

items.title: Coco
items.whereToFind: Disney+ (Spanish audio, Latin American dub, Spanish subtitles)
items.why: A story you probably know, set in Mexico, with clear speech. Knowing the plot makes the Spanish easier to follow.

items.title: Encanto
items.why: Colombian setting and songs you can rewatch. Songs are great for shadowing.

items.title: Duolingo Spanish Podcast
items.why: True stories told in slow, clear Spanish with short English bridges. Good for bus rides and walks.

items.title: Easy Spanish
items.why: Street interviews with real people in Mexico, Argentina, Spain and more, with Spanish and English subtitles. Hear many accents.

items.title: Españolistos
items.why: Conversations made for intermediate learners, with a Colombian host. Natural topics at a friendly pace.

items.title: Español con Juan
items.why: A funny teacher explaining grammar and culture entirely in Spanish. Peninsular accent.

items.title: Notes in Spanish
items.why: Real conversations between a Spanish speaker and a learner, from intermediate to advanced.

items.title: Club de Cuervos
items.why: A comedy-drama about a football club. Everyday Mexican Spanish and lots of family arguments.

items.title: Radio Ambulante
items.whereToFind: Any podcast app; transcripts on the website and in the Lupa app
items.why: Beautifully told true stories from all over Latin America. Read the transcript when it gets hard.

items.title: El Hilo
items.why: Weekly news from Latin America, clearly explained. Builds the vocabulary for living there.

items.title: Luis Miguel: La Serie
items.why: A gripping biopic. Strong story pull is what makes long extensive viewing easy.

items.title: La Casa de Papel
items.why: Fast and addictive. Spanish from Spain, so a good contrast to Latin American accents.

items.title: Roma
items.why: Quiet, everyday Mexico City life in 1970s Spanish. Slow enough to follow without subtitles.

items.title: La Casa de las Flores
items.why: Fast, funny and full of idioms and Mexico City slang.

items.title: El Marginal
items.why: Heavy Rioplatense slang and voseo: a real challenge, and great if Argentina is on your map.
